defs.meaning: 感谢的，感激的；（表示）感谢（或感激）的

examples.en: I was thankful that he hadn't been hurt.
examples.zh: 他没有受伤，我感到很欣慰。

examples.en: I was thankful to see they'd all arrived safely.
examples.zh: 看到他们都平安到达，我感到欣慰。

examples.en: Most of the time I'm just thankful that I've got a job.
examples.zh: 大部分时候我庆幸自己有了份工作。
